params.prompt: Cinematic photoreal scene, square 1:1, dark warm palette (#0B0907 shadows). In the lower half of the frame: a row of seven identical tall dark glass showcase panels standing on a dark stone floor of a dark showroom, receding gently in perspective from left to right; only the first, leftmost panel is lit from inside with a warm yellow (#FDD506) glow, the other six are dim and barely visible, their edges catching a faint warm rim light. Thin haze, subtle golden dust in the light beam. The upper 55% of the frame is nearly black and empty for typography. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark. Premium, calm, one-of-seven mood.
